title: rateLawBench operation
description: A rate law written in the case, on the bench, without a reactor around it. The law is the case's own: `reaction <name>;` names a reaction of constant/reactions whose kinetics are `type expression;`, and the bench prints it back as the engine PARSED it, every number with its unit. LOCUS (optional): sweep temperature at fixed conversions of a key reactant, walked from a base mixture along the reaction's own stoichiometry, and locate the temperature of the greatest value of a reported quantity -- for a reversible exothermic reaction the locus DESCENDS, the curve a quench converter zigzags about. POINTS (optional): the law at states the case declares. What is published is the case's choice (`report`). The bench holds no anchors of its own: a law's checks are a gate's (bin/curate/check_ammonia_rate.py for the ammonia law). It replaced the ammonia-only `ammoniaRateBench` on 2026-10-12 (DEV.md 4c C67), when the Dyson & Simon law left the engine for the case.

report.title: What to publish
report.description: Each a parameter, a definition, or the law's own `rate` (or `forward` / `reverse` when it declares its legs), converted to the declared unit, whose dimensions must be the quantity's. Published per point as `<label>_<name>` and per locus point as `locus<k>_<name>`. Required: what the bench prints is never a default.

name.title: Quantity
name.description: A parameter or definition of the law, or rate / forward / reverse.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: The unit it is shown and published in (`-` for a pure number).

locus.title: The locus of maximum rate
locus.description: Optional. Sweep temperature at each declared conversion and report where the `maximise` quantity is greatest. A maximum found ON an end of the sweep is reported as an edge rather than as a maximum.

maximise.title: Quantity located
maximise.description: One of the `report` entries; its maximum over the sweep is the locus point.

keyReactant.title: Key reactant
keyReactant.description: The reactant whose conversion the locus is drawn against; it must be present in the base mixture.

baseMixture.title: Base mixture
baseMixture.description: Mole fractions at zero conversion; must sum to 1 (refused, never normalised). Components outside the reaction are carried as inerts.

conversions.title: Conversions of the key reactant
conversions.description: One conversion gives one point of the locus; the locus is the sequence, and a single point cannot show that it descends.

temperature.title: Temperature sweep
temperature.description: The window swept at each conversion.

to.title: Upper temperature
to.description: End of the sweep; must exceed `from`.

n.title: Points
n.description: Number of temperatures swept, at least 2.

points.title: Declared states
points.description: Optional. Evaluate the law at gases the case declares -- typically the states another case computed. Nothing is ranked or compared. When the law declares `forward`/`reverse` legs and an `equilibriumTemperatureWindow`, the temperature at which each gas is at the law's own equilibrium is published too (`<label>_T_eq_K`).

label.title: Name
label.description: A single word; it keys this state's published diagnostics.

composition.title: Bulk mole fractions
composition.description: Must sum to 1: a composition that does not close is REFUSED rather than normalised, because renormalising would hide which entry is wrong. Names outside the reaction (an `inert`, say) are carried as inerts.
